candidate_reconstruction.combination_primary: maximize the number of tagged jets among the four candidates
candidate_reconstruction.historical_parity: for events with at least four tagged jets, exactly reproduce the frozen rich-v2 up-to-eight-b-jet reconstruction
candidate_reconstruction.pool: up to eight selected jets ordered by b-tag flag descending, pT descending, selected-jet index ascending

comparison_weights.auxiliary_qcd_budget: within the qcd_multijet family, fix the auxiliary share in every outer fold to its full-train candidate-bearing source fraction

cut_policy.new_optimization: nested five-fold source-group OOF on the full-production train resolved view after common-table scale-out

physical_weights.formula: run2 coefficient per generator weight times signed generator_nominal_weight
